# FIT5145 Assignment 1 & 3: Data-Driven Pacing Corridor for First-Timer Hyrox Athletes

### Load tidyverse

```{R}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{R}
szn8_male_pro <- read_csv("data/hyrox_season8_male_pro.csv")
glimpse(szn8_male_pro)
szn8_male_pro %>% distinct(Division)
szn8_male_pro %>% filter(is.na(Division))
szn8_male_pro %>% head(10)
```

```{R}
szn8_female_pro <- read_csv("data/hyrox_season8_female_pro.csv")

szn8_female_pro %>% head(10)
```
